channel.title: Press Releases
channel.description: Official announcements highlighting recent actions taken by the SEC and other newsworthy information.

item.title: SEC Charges Former Executives With Fraud in Connection With $1.9 Billion Collapse of Subprime Auto Lender Tricolor
item.description: The Securities and Exchange Commission today charged Daniel Chu, Jerome Kollar, and Ameryn Seibold, the former CEO, CFO, and Senior Director of Finance, respectively, at Texas-based Tricolor Holdings, LLC, for their roles in an alleged multi-year scheme.

item.title: SEC Proposes New Regulation Crypto Assets
item.description: The Securities and Exchange Commission proposed a new regulation governing crypto assets, including registration, disclosure and custody requirements for digital-asset intermediaries.

item.title: SEC Establishes Financial Reporting and Accounting Unit in Enforcement Division
item.description: The SEC today established a new Financial Reporting and Accounting Unit in its Enforcement Division to focus on accounting and financial reporting issues.
